Blinding for the possession experiment rests on PROCESS separation -- the runner, the result-integrity node and the adjudication node are separate contexts with separate write scopes, enforced by the graph -- not on cryptography. That was always the design; this finding removes the temptation to treat the crypto as a second line of defence when it is not one. A remediation node is created rather than leaving the criterion silently overstated.

authority: coordinator, from the derivation source and a live reproduction
made_by: coordinator
question: P30 read BLOCKED with an EMPTY blocking list after every dependency was PASSED or SUPERSEDED-with-a-PASSED-successor. Engine defect?
ruling: YES -- the third engine defect surfaced by live operation, now fixed with a regression test. Supersession pointers are not dependency edges, so a successor (R11) can sit LATER in the deterministic topological order than a node depending on the superseded one (P30: 'P' sorts before 'R', and no edge forces R11 earlier). The single topological pass consulted the successor's status before it was assigned, leaving the dependent BLOCKED while the after-the-fact blocked_on computation -- run against the completed status map -- correctly found nothing blocking. The G02-to-R15 supersession masked this earlier because real dependency edges were also rewired onto R15, forcing it early in the order. Fix: a fixed-point pass over non-forced nodes after the topological pass; the fixed point is order-independent, so derivation stays deterministic. Regression test reproduces the exact live shape and the internal inconsistency (BLOCKED with empty blocked_on) that betrayed it. Pattern note for the ledger: all three engine defects (K1 forbidden-inputs rendering, K2 audit-independence type filter, this) were invisible to the engine's own suite and surfaced only under live structure -- the suite tests what I thought to assert, the graph exercises what is actually true.

made_by: on-duty coordinator (successor), 2026-08-07, executing a direct user directive
preserved_disagreement: The user asked for an automatic trigger ON the context threshold. What is delivered is a coordinator that TRIGGERS ITSELF at a self-judged threshold. That distinction is real and is recorded rather than smoothed away: no external watchdog verifies the coordinator actually retires at 60 percent, so a coordinator that misjudges its own context can still overrun. The daily cron backstop bounds the damage to at most one day of stall, not to zero. If a true external trigger is wanted later it would need a harness feature that does not currently exist.
question: The user changed the coordinator schedule to daily and stated a preference: succession should trigger when the ACTIVE coordinator hits 60 percent of its context window - winding down work in process, writing a handoff, then triggering the next coordinator - rather than firing on a clock. Can that be implemented, and how?
ruling: IMPLEMENTED, WITH ONE HONEST SUBSTITUTION THE USER MUST KNOW ABOUT. There is NO harness mechanism that fires a scheduled task on context-window consumption; schedules are cron or one-shot fireAt only. So the trigger is INVERTED rather than built: the coordinator self-assesses its own context and, on crossing the threshold, performs the wind-down and then creates a ONE-TIME scheduled task firing about 3 minutes out to summon its successor. The observable behaviour is what the user asked for - retirement and succession driven by context rather than the clock - but the mechanism is coordinator self-discipline, not an external monitor. Two limits are stated rather than papered over: a coordinator cannot query an exact context percentage, so 60 percent is a self-assessed judgment (hence the instruction to err EARLY, never late, because a coordinator that runs out mid-handoff hands over nothing); and scheduled tasks only fire while the app is open, so the daily cron is retained as a SAFETY NET rather than removed. A DESIGN DEADLOCK WAS FOUND AND FIXED BEFORE SHIPPING. Self-triggered succession would have deadlocked against the existing staleness guard: the successor fires ~3 minutes after the predecessor's handoff commit, sees a ledger event far under the 30-minute threshold, concludes another coordinator is live, and stands down - leaving the program dark until the safety-net run. This is not hypothetical: it happened live on 2026-08-07, when a scheduled coordinator stood down against a 9-minute-old ledger while its predecessor was in fact retiring. The fix is a marker plus an override: the retiring coordinator's LAST ledger write is a `coordinator_retired` event, and the staleness guard now reads - stand down if the newest event is under 30 minutes old AND is not `coordinator_retired`; if it IS `coordinator_retired`, you were deliberately summoned, so proceed immediately. Shipped in two places so it cannot be lost: GRAPH_POLICY section 12.3.1 (the law, carried verbatim into every future handoff packet) and the scheduled task's own prompt at C:\Users\jgallagher\.claude\scheduled-tasks\wnba-coordinator-on-duty\SKILL.md.

It applies roughly the same burden of proof to 'is there something interesting here?' as to 'should this become part of the production model?', which is expensive and discourages creativity, because every strange idea requires hours of ceremony. How should the process change?
ruling: ADOPTED IN FULL, WITH ONE COORDINATOR ADDITION THE USER SHOULD RULE ON. Shipped as GRAPH_POLICY section 13: four evidence levels E0 Exploration / E1 Signal candidate / E2 Challenger / E3 Production, with the existing heavy machinery reserved for E2/E3 and E0/E1 made deliberately fast, disposable and EXPLICITLY NON-CLAIMING (no registry entry, no preregistration, no leaderboard row, no report - output is a one-line kill/keep log entry, and a lead is never a result). Effort allocation set to roughly 70 percent signal discovery / 20 percent validation of survivors / 10 percent infrastructure, with the priority target being the player-level residual. Global MAE is explicitly demoted as the psychological centre of the program in favour of conditional edge plus abstention. THE USER'S DIAGNOSIS IS CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT, not merely accepted: across this session's ledger, ideation nodes consumed 4 minutes of agent time against 948 minutes for everything else - 0.4 percent. The imbalance was worse than the critique implied. COORDINATOR ADDITION (section 13.2), flagged as an addition rather than smuggled in: E0/E1 must run ONLY on a designated exploration partition, and the E2 confirmation holdout must never be read during exploration. This is the enabling condition for speed, not a tax on it. Without it, screening 50 ideas and promoting the 2 that look persistent means those 2 were SELECTED USING THE DATA MEANT TO CONFIRM THEM, so the subsequent preregistration preregisters a hypothesis the data already chose - selection leakage at program scale, the same family as the arm-G leak worth 16x its reported gain and the apparent breakthroughs that evaporated. WITH the partition, screening 50 ideas costs nothing statistically because confirmation lands on data the search never saw. The user's own framing anticipated this risk ('removing those protections would probably make the project move faster while making you falsely confident much more often'); 13.2 is the minimum mechanism that gets the speed without the false confidence. A second, cheaper addition: an E2 preregistration discloses how many E0 leads its campaign screened, so a reader can distinguish a 1-of-50 survivor from a 1-of-2 survivor. NOT CHANGED, and deliberately so: the E2/E3 machinery itself. The user was explicit that the existing harness is excellent for those tiers and that the rigor is valuable. Nothing in this ruling weakens preregistration, walk-forward, leakage audit, timestamp discipline or the untouched holdout AT THE TIER WHERE THEY APPLY. The change is where the line sits, not how strong the line is.

ruling: OPTION (A) - RUN THE MISSING MEASUREMENTS - WITH PROPORTIONAL RIGOR. The user's ruling verbatim: 'Choose (a): run the missing measurements. Do not shrink the model merely to avoid auditing inputs we have every reason to believe are valid.' THE OPERATIVE STANDARD, TWO TIERS: TIER 1 CHEAP PROVENANCE RECEIPT, for fields whose VALUE IS FIXED BY THE SCHEDULE BEFORE TIPOFF - opponent identity, home/away, season type, scheduled rest / back-to-back / 3-in-4 classes, venue, timezone and the venue-shift hours. EXPLICITLY REJECTED: option (c) - the model is NOT to be shrunk merely to avoid auditing inputs there is every reason to believe are valid. question: The inherited packet records that every dR2 from the shared E0 `wls_r2` helper is '~8% smaller' than the standard weighted figure, direction conservative, and that cross-screen rankings are 'quietly incomparable until one convention is adopted'. Decide what to do.

what_the_coordinator_verified_rather_tha.the_defect_is_real_and_is_as_described: wls_r2 computes sst = sum((yw - yw.mean())**2) where yw = sqrt(w)*y - the SST of the sqrt-weight-transformed response about ITS OWN mean - rather than the standard weighted SST about the weighted mean, sum(w*(y - mu_w)**2) with mu_w = sum(w*y)/sum(w). SSE is identical under both, so the discrepancy is a PURE DENOMINATOR EFFECT and the ratio of reported to standard dR2 is exactly sst_standard/sst_defective.
what_the_coordinator_verified_rather_tha.THERE_IS_NO_SHARED_HELPER_TO_FIX: The packet calls it 'the shared E0 wls_r2 helper'. IT IS NOT SHARED. It is COPY-PASTED into six separate analyze.py files: exploration/E0_I0005_turnover_interaction, E0_I0006_usage_redistribution, E0_I0009_additive_pressure, E0_I0010_positional_matchup, E1_I0009_additive_pressure, and market_program/M07_BOOK_LEAD_LAG. There is no single edit that fixes it and no import graph to repair. This materially changes what 'cheap to fix' means and was not recorded before.
what_the_coordinator_verified_rather_tha.THE_8_PERCENT_FIGURE_IS_A_SINGLE_POINT_N: Measured directly across realistic configurations, the bias ranges from EXACTLY 0% to -25.3%. It is governed by TWO factors, and vanishes when either is absent: (1) WEIGHT DISPERSION - with uniform weights the ratio is exactly 1.0000; (2) THE RESPONSE'S MEAN-TO-SD RATIO - with a CENTERED response (mean 0) the ratio is exactly 1.0000 regardless of how dispersed the weights are. The mechanism is that sqrt(w)*mean(y) varies with w, and that variation enters the defective SST, inflating it. Measured values at n=40,000: points (mean 9.0, sd 7.0) with minutes weights 10-40 -> -5.1%, same target with minutes 1-40 including bench players -> -13.4%; rebounds -4.9% / -13.5%; assists -2.6% / -8.2%; a per-36 rate (mean 15, sd 8) -> -10.0% / -25.3%; a centered residual -> 0.0% in every weighting.

ruling.1_DO_NOT_EDIT_THE_FROZEN_SCREEN_COPIES: Editing the six copies would silently change numbers already recorded in shipped FINDINGS/NOTES artifacts and would break the reproducibility those screens claim. The copies stay as they are. This is deliberate, not neglect.
ruling.2_CONVENTION_FOR_FUTURE_SCREENS: PLAIN UNWEIGHTED OLS R2 = 1 - SSE/SST with SST about the unweighted mean, DECLARED EXPLICITLY in FINDINGS.json, unless a screen has a substantive reason to weight. This is not a new imposition - it is ratifying what the program has already converged on independently: I0012, and all three screens dispatched this session (I0004, I0008, I0012-survivor), each chose plain unweighted OLS and declared it. A screen that DOES need weights must use the standard weighted SST about the weighted mean and say so.
ruling.3_PAST_NUMBERS_CANNOT_BE_RESCUED_BY_A_MU: This is the operationally important consequence and it CORRECTS the inherited framing. Because the bias depends on each screen's own weight dispersion and response centering, there is NO single correction factor - multiplying an old dR2 by 1.08 is not a valid restatement. Any past weighted number that needs to be compared like-for-like against a new one must be RE-RUN under the adopted convention, not rescaled.
ruling.4_NOTHING_IS_OVERSTATED: The direction is conservative in every configuration measured (reported <= standard, ratio <= 1.0000). No verdict recorded in this program is overturned by this, and no lead was kept alive by it. That part of the inherited assessment is confirmed.

raised_for_the_user_not_decided: THE ONE LIVE LEAD THIS TOUCHES IS I0009. E0_I0009_additive_pressure and E1_I0009_additive_pressure both carry the defective helper, and I0009 is currently the program's strongest surviving lead (keep-as-lead at E1, honest walk-forward figure +0.004003). Its numbers are therefore UNDERSTATED by an unknown amount between 0% and ~25%, depending on whether its response was centered and how dispersed its weights are - the coordinator did NOT re-run I0009 to determine which, because that is measurement work on a live lead rather than a convention decision, and because 12.11.3 item 6 asked for a decision. FLAGGED so it is not discovered later as a surprise: if I0009 is ever ranked against a lead measured under plain OLS, the comparison is invalid until I0009 is re-run. The three leads screened this session are all plain-OLS and are mutually comparable. Every other screen carrying the helper (I0005, I0006, I0010) is already DEAD, and M07_BOOK_LEAD_LAG is a passed market-lane node whose verdict does not depend on a dR2 magnitude.
preserved_disagreement: The coordinator notes that adopting plain unweighted OLS as the default is a convenience convention, not a statistical improvement per se: where observations genuinely have unequal information content (a 4-minute appearance versus a 38-minute one), an unweighted fit is not obviously the better estimator, it is merely the one whose R2 is unambiguous. The convention is adopted for COMPARABILITY and because the program has already converged on it in practice, not on the claim that weighting is wrong. A screen with a substantive reason to weight should weight, declare the standard convention, and say why - that route is explicitly left open above.
evidence: Quantified by direct numerical measurement this session (n=20,000 and n=40,000 synthetic designs spanning five weight regimes and five response profiles), not inherited. The uniform-weight and centered-response cases both return a ratio of exactly 1.0000, which is the analytic prediction and confirms the mechanism is correctly identified.

kit_contents.detect_grouping_level: reports distinct values and constancy at each candidate key and names the COARSEST CONSTANT level - the function that would have caught all six instances of the wrong-null trap
kit_contents.permutation_null: permutes only the ASSIGNMENT of already-computed values at an explicitly named level; group_col has NO DEFAULT, None raises, and it also raises if the feature is not constant at the named level. ROW_LEVEL must be passed by name, so it can never be reached by accident
kit_contents.null_width_comparison: runs both nulls at the same seed and reports sd_correct/sd_row so every screen surfaces the inflation factor
kit_contents.noop_placebo: asserts sd < 1e-15 rather than bitwise zero, and RETURNS the observed sd so the caller reports it honestly
kit_contents.assert_partition: value-based only; docstring states why a textual scan is the wrong check

Established (>=20 prior) at <14 min: +7.64% (p .001). Established at >=24 min: -0.53% (p .30). what_the_coordinator_verified_rather_tha.WHY_THE_MINUTES_SKILL_CANNOT_RESCUE_POIN: On the >=20-prior, >=24-minute row: minutes skill +7.7%, rate skill -0.5%, points skill -0.5%. what_the_coordinator_verified_rather_tha.THE_CEILING_IS_REAL_BUT_IT_IS_NOT_THE_EX: 51.3% of points variance is irreducible even to an ORACLE THAT KNOWS PLAYER IDENTITY AND ACTUAL REALISED MINUTES. THAT IS ~0.076 R2, or 5.5% of MAE, OF REACHABLE HEADROOM THE CHAMPION HAS NOT CAPTURED. So 'points is mostly unforecastable' and 'the champion is leaving real value on the table' are both true, and quoting either alone misrepresents the finding.

this_BOUNDS_D076s_abstention_finding: Step 5 screened 550 cells for pre-game predictors of differential skill on the RATE components. WHY_THIS_PARTIAL_WORK_WAS_ESPECIALLY_DAN: The directory contains a 34 KB FINDINGS.json, efficiency_contrast.csv, points_contrast.csv, arithmetic_ceiling.csv and a 7.5 MB permutation-draws file. IT ALL LOOKS FINISHED. It is not. The agent's final transmission before dying was: 'The uncentred allowance is a level shift, not a cross-sectional signal - I need to fix that before computing any contrast.' IT WAS REPORTING THAT THE CONSTRUCTION UNDERLYING EVERY CONTRAST IN THAT DIRECTORY IS WRONG AND UNFIXED. The artifacts therefore embody the PRE-FIX construction. This is precisely the hazard GRAPH_POLICY 12 anticipates: the danger of dead-agent output is not that it is obviously broken, it is that IT CAN LOOK COMPLETE. A coordinator in a hurry would have committed a defective contrast as a screened result.
the_methodological_point_carried_forward: An opponent conversion-allowance term used UNCENTRED shifts every prediction by roughly the same amount instead of discriminating between opponents - a LEVEL SHIFT, NOT A CROSS-SECTIONAL SIGNAL - so a contrast built on it measures almost nothing about matchup. It must be centred against the point-in-time league mean before any contrast is computed. THIS IS THE SAME DISTINCTION RECORDED IN D080, where the `*_pregame` shrinkage anchor was found to be a season-level scalar shared by all teams: harmless for a cross-sectional claim, not harmless for a level claim. TWO AGENTS HAVE NOW REACHED IT INDEPENDENTLY FROM OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS. It is carried into the retry brief as an established design requirement rather than left to be rediscovered a third time. Note carefully: this is a DESIGN CONSIDERATION inherited from a dead agent, NOT a finding claimed from its unusable output - the distinction matters and is being held deliberately.
process_improvement_added_to_the_retry_b: The retry is instructed to (a) write per-step results to disk incrementally so an interruption leaves interpretable state, and (b) WRITE ANY SELF-IDENTIFIED DEFECT TO DISK IMMEDIATELY rather than holding it for the final message. THE DEAD AGENT'S SINGLE MOST VALUABLE OUTPUT WAS A WARNING THAT NEARLY DIED WITH IT - it survived only because the harness captured a fragment of its last transmission. preserved_disagreement: The coordinator notes it cannot fully verify that the dead agent's self-diagnosis was correct. It is being taken at its word that the uncentred allowance is a level shift, because the claim is mechanically obvious and independently corroborated by D080 - but it arrives from an agent whose work is formally unusable, and a stricter reading of GRAPH_POLICY 12 would discard the warning along with the numbers. The coordinator's position is that discarding a correctness warning because its author died would be perverse, and that the retry will in any case rebuild and re-verify the construction from scratch. A_NEW_TRAP_SHAPE_THE_PROGRAM_HAS_NOT_REC.name: REFERENCE INCOMPLETENESS
A_NEW_TRAP_SHAPE_THE_PROGRAM_HAS_NOT_REC.what_it_is: The candidate does not read the future and the baseline is not retrospective. THE REFERENCE IS SIMPLY INCOMPLETE: it measured the player's prior efficiency ONE way (points-per-minute) while the candidate smuggled in a SECOND measurement of the same underlying quantity (prior eFG). The increment is then not new information at all - it is the reference's own blind spot, re-entered through the candidate.
A_NEW_TRAP_SHAPE_THE_PROGRAM_HAS_NOT_REC.WHY_IT_IS_DANGEROUS: IT PASSES EVERY EXISTING GUARD. The future-leakage probe passed it with maximum confidence, because nothing reads the future. The entity-swap null passed it, because the signal is genuinely non-random. The correct-level permutation null passed it at family-wise p 0.0017. THE PERMUTATION MACHINERY CANNOT SEE IT, because the effect is real - it is simply not incremental. ONLY DECOMPOSITION CAUGHT IT.
A_NEW_TRAP_SHAPE_THE_PROGRAM_HAS_NOT_REC.THE_DEFENCE: Put EVERY available prior measurement of the target quantity in the base, not just the one that names the outcome. Then decompose any surviving candidate against its own components. This is the same discipline that killed D085's foul-draw interaction and 10 of 12 interactions here - and it should now be a STANDING STEP in every screen, not an occasional check.
A_NEW_TRAP_SHAPE_THE_PROGRAM_HAS_NOT_REC.relationship_to_the_known_traps: This is NOT the retrospective-baseline trap (nothing reads the future) and NOT the wrong-null trap (the null was correct). It is a THIRD, INDEPENDENT failure mode, and the program has now paid for it once.

THE_RECOMMENDED_OPERATING_RULE: When the champion flags a row as fallback - equivalently, fewer than 3 prior same-season appearances, 7.6% of rows and 7.8% of the decision-relevant population - replace its forecast with lambda(n)*own_running_mean + (1-lambda(n))*(league + depth-chart-rank deviation + draft-slot deviation), with lambda(n) = n/(n+2). EXPECTED GAIN: pooled points skill from -0.22% to +3.51%, and points MAE on those rows from 6.06 to 4.02. For comparison, D081's crude running-mean splice gave +1.36%.
THE_CENTRAL_MECHANICAL_FACT_AND_IT_REFRA: ON THE DATA-POOR TIER THE CHAMPION EMITS A CONSTANT. 8.704 points with a standard deviation of 0.013, and 21.62 minutes with a standard deviation of 0.09 - FOR EVERY PLAYER, ACROSS ALL THREE SEASONS - against a truth standard deviation of 7.2 points. It is not modelling those players at all; it is emitting a league-average placeholder. THE USER'S 'SMART FILLER SCORE' IS EXACTLY WHAT THAT CONSTANT SHOULD BE, and the entire finding is that the current constant is the wrong one rather than that a placeholder is a new idea.
THE_DAMAGE_IS_NOT_WHERE_ANYONE_ASSUMED_A: SKILL IS NON-MONOTONE IN PRIOR APPEARANCES. The same shape appears on career games (1-2 career games: dR2 -0.7446) and on prior minutes (1-24 minutes: dR2 -0.4737). MECHANISM: at zero priors BOTH the champion and the reference are constants, so neither can win - the reference is what moves, not the model. THE DAMAGE IS CONCENTRATED WHERE THE PLAYER HAS ONE OR TWO OBSERVATIONS THAT THE MODEL IGNORES, not where they have none. That inverts the intuition the coordinator and the user were both working from.

The model already knows which rows it cannot handle; it simply emits a poor constant for them.

authority: D091 (user directive) authorised per-player and per-cluster work and directed this diagnostic. The champion was scored, never retrained.
question: D091 recorded the user's hypothesis that the program's nulls are artefacts of two choices: no realised-minutes floor, and pooling across heterogeneous players. Both were tested directly.
verdict: BOTH ANSWERS ARE NEGATIVE, AND THE AGENT REFUTED ITS OWN POSITIVE RESULT TO GET THERE. One genuine positive survives, but it is a pooled interaction rather than an argument for per-player models.

ANSWER_1_THE_MINUTES_FLOOR_DOES_NOT_CHAN.the_result: Points-per-minute skill against the STRONGEST prior-only reference facing the SAME filtered rows, by realised-minutes floor: +0.559% (n=13,879) at floor 0, then +0.283% at 10, +0.170% at 15, +0.443% at 20, +0.514% at 25, +0.219% at 30 (n=3,804). FLAT, NO TREND. D081 reproduced exactly first, worst delta 9.7e-17 across all nine cells.
ANSWER_1_THE_MINUTES_FLOOR_DOES_NOT_CHAN.THE_APPARENT_RISE_IS_THE_REFERENCE_DEGRA: A 7.6x rise (+0.559% to +4.237%) DOES appear - but only against a reference refitted on the filtered rows, and that reference is getting WORSE: at floor 30 its MAE is 0.1499 against the frozen reference's 0.1439. Measured against whichever reference is actually strongest, the curve is flat.
ANSWER_1_THE_MINUTES_FLOOR_DOES_NOT_CHAN.THE_USER_S_MECHANISM_WAS_REAL_AND_THE_EX: The floor removes 39.3% of points-per-minute variance and 44.7% of the within-player component - the garbage-time noise the user identified is genuinely there and genuinely large. AND IT CHANGES WHICH REFERENCE WINS: a mean-of-prior-ratios estimator wins at floor 0, and a ratio-of-prior-sums estimator wins from floor 10 upward. The second is exactly the estimator garbage time cannot corrupt. SO THE RATIO NOISE WAS LIVING IN THE REFERENCE, WHICH HAD ALREADY ABSORBED IT - and the champion never got the benefit. The user was right about the noise and right that it mattered; it had simply already been priced into the comparison.

ANSWER_2_PER_PLAYER_HETEROGENEITY_IS_NOT.the_initial_positive: Under the directive's within-player shuffle null, per-player coefficient spread ratios ran 1.09-1.24 and the family-wise max statistic CLEARED at floors 0, 10 and 15 (p 0.0055, 0.0045, 0.0080) - though notably NOT at the preregistered floor 20 (p 0.0915). That is exactly the result the user hypothesised.
ANSWER_2_PER_PLAYER_HETEROGENEITY_IS_NOT.THE_AGENT_DISTRUSTED_ITS_OWN_POSITIVE_AN: Three of the six regressors are running means of the player's own history, with within-player lag-1 autocorrelation from +0.55 to +0.91. A PLAIN SHUFFLE DESTROYS THAT SERIAL STRUCTURE while the response keeps its own slow drift, so the null is too narrow and the observed spread looks anomalous. The agent built a WITHIN-PLAYER CYCLIC-SHIFT null, which preserves the marginal distribution AND the serial structure, and the excess VANISHES AT EVERY FLOOR: family-wise p 0.625, 0.334, 0.383, 0.623, 0.661, 0.460. NOTHING CLEARS ANYWHERE.
ANSWER_2_PER_PLAYER_HETEROGENEITY_IS_NOT.THE_INTERNAL_VALIDATION_IS_WHAT_MAKES_TH: Verified on bytes in serial_structure_diagnostic.csv. The shuffle-minus-cyclic gap tracks the regressor's autocorrelation almost perfectly - correlation +0.832 across 48 cells. Concretely: own-usage (acf 0.912) shows a gap of 0.186 and moves from shuffle p 0.0015 to cyclic p 0.393; prior-efficiency persistence (acf 0.619) shows a gap of 0.211; while the three opponent terms (acf 0.064 to 0.095) show gaps of 0.002 to 0.010, and BOTH IID NOISE CONTROLS (acf -0.033 and -0.025) show gaps of 0.004 and 0.013. THE GAP APPEARS ONLY WHERE THE REGRESSOR IS AUTOCORRELATED. That is a clean mechanism, not a hand-wave.

THE_ONE_GENUINE_POSITIVE_AND_IT_IS_A_DIF: Per-player sensitivity to opponent defence RISES with the player's own strictly-prior usage: Spearman +0.320, family-wise p 0.0035 across the six preregistered relationships, UNDER THE CYCLIC NULL, with both negative controls null (p 0.204 and 0.939). Own-usage sensitivity behaves the same (+0.281, p 0.0045), and it survives making the response relative to the player's own prior rate (+0.454 to +0.405 weighted), so it is not merely a scale effect. BUT NOTE WHAT IT IS: THIS IS A USAGE-BY-OPPONENT-DEFENCE INTERACTION - ONE POOLED TERM - NOT AN ARGUMENT FOR PER-PLAYER MODELS. The variation is real and it is EXPLAINABLE by an observable, which makes it a feature to add rather than a reason to fragment the model.
THE_SINGLE_PLAYER_CEILING_THE_USER_ASKED: Five best-sampled players, 102-107 retained games each, strict expanding walk-forward by date with at least 25 prior games required to fit. EVERY ONE LOSES TO THAT PLAYER'S OWN STRICTLY-PRIOR AVERAGE. Verified on bytes: walk-forward R2 is NEGATIVE on all ten player-floor cells for the six-feature model, ranging -0.052 to -0.197, and the one-feature model is negative in eight of ten. At floor 20 the mean skill is -6.66% (six-feature) and -3.37% (one-feature). IN-SAMPLE R2 ON THE SAME ROWS IS +0.04 TO +0.18 - SO ALL APPARENT FIT IS OPTIMISM. This is the program's power ceiling per player, it had never been measured, and it bounds every per-player and per-cluster scheme: with maximum data on the best-sampled players in the league, a fitted model is worse than that player's own running average.

THE_SEVENTH_REASON_NOBODY_LISTED_AND_IT_.the_finding: THE NULL MACHINERY ITSELF WAS A REASON THE PROGRAM'S RESULTS COULD BE WRONG - in this case wrong in the FALSE-POSITIVE direction. `SCHEME_WITHIN` is ANTICONSERVATIVE FOR AUTOCORRELATED REGRESSORS, giving p 0.0015 where the honest null gives 0.39. AND THE PROGRAM'S MOST COMMON CONSTRUCTION IS `.shift(1).expanding()`, WHICH IS AUTOCORRELATED BY DESIGN.
THE_SEVENTH_REASON_NOBODY_LISTED_AND_IT_.the_second_half_is_worse: `noop_placebo` CONFIRMED that relabelling the player key and refitting per-player coefficients is a LITERAL NO-OP - observed sd 5.207e-17. THE CONTROL AN ANALYST WOULD NATURALLY REACH FOR TESTS NOTHING AT ALL. That is the same shape as the row-level trap this program has now caught nine times, one level down: a control that cannot fail, giving false assurance.
THE_SEVENTH_REASON_NOBODY_LISTED_AND_IT_.why_it_matters_beyond_this_screen: This screen WOULD HAVE PUBLISHED A FALSE POSITIVE - and it would have been the most consequential false positive in the program's history, because it would have appeared to confirm the user's hypothesis and justified fragmenting the model. What is properly established is that THE SPECIFIC HETEROGENEITY THE PROGRAM'S EXISTING RELATIONSHIPS COULD EXHIBIT IS NOT THERE, and that per-player fitting is power-starved. verdict: NEITHER. The dichotomy was false, the effect is real, it is mostly NOT about volume concentration, and it is roughly FOUR TIMES SMALLER than headlined.
THE_TENSION_THE_COORDINATOR_AND_D098_BOT: The +0.024 versus +0.0002 contrast that framed this entire investigation compares TWO DIFFERENT THINGS ON TWO DIFFERENT ROW SETS. The +0.0002 is a linear interaction added to a model THAT ALREADY CARRIES DEFENCE, scored on all 4,514 stratum rows. The +0.024 is the WHOLE DEFENCE FAMILY added to a model with NO DEFENCE AT ALL, scored on 1,687 rows. PUT ON THE SAME FOOTING, THE LINEAR INTERACTION ON THOSE ROWS IS +0.004466. D098 framed the tension, the coordinator adopted it, wrote a brief around it, and dispatched an agent to resolve it - and it was an artefact of comparing incomparable quantities. The agent found this by construction rather than by argument.
REFIT_ARTEFACT_IS_DECISIVELY_REFUTED: Verified on bytes in refit_decomposition.csv. THE REFIT GAIN IS GENERIC AND THE DEFENCE GAIN IS SPECIFIC: refitting WITHOUT any defence term gains +0.033319 on the top tercile and +0.033762 on the MIDDLE tercile - essentially identical, so refitting a subset helps regardless of which subset. But the DEFENCE gain is +0.023863 on the top tercile against +0.005179 on the middle, a 4.6x difference. AND THE DEFENCE GAIN NEEDS NO REFIT AT ALL: freezing every non-defence coefficient at its POOLED value and adding only the defence term recovers 99% (+0.023659). Absolute accounting seals it - the same pooled coefficient cuts SSE by 1.3506 on the top tercile while INCREASING it by 0.0472 on the bottom and 0.1656 on the middle, and sd(T3)/sd(all) is 0.976 so it is not a denominator effect.
BUT_THRESHOLD_IS_ALSO_LARGELY_REFUTED_AN: The gain decomposes as: A SINGLE POOLED DEFENCE COEFFICIENT WITH NO VOLUME HETEROGENEITY OF ANY KIND = 70%; adding a linear usage interaction = +19%; MAKING IT A STEP RATHER THAN A LINE = +3%; the full tier-restricted refit = +8%. THE 'CONCENTRATED IN HIGH-VOLUME PLAYERS' STORY ACCOUNTS FOR ABOUT A FIFTH OF THE EFFECT AND THE STEP ITSELF FOR THREE PERCENT. What is actually there is a pooled opponent-defence effect that helps high-volume players and hurts low-volume ones. The step does genuinely beat the line - on the full stratum +0.003317 against +0.000203, a 16x ratio clearing the swap null at z +3.55 - but that is a small increment on top of something that is mostly not heterogeneous at all.
THE_HEADLINE_OVERSTATES_ITSELF_BY_ROUGHL: D098's +0.023863 was computed on the 1,687-row subset, whose SST is 36% of the stratum's. On a COMMON DENOMINATOR the honest figures, verified in absolute_accounting.csv, are dR2 +0.005028 on points-per-minute and +0.003335 on points across the full decision stratum - or +0.005968 and +0.004909 expressed as the top tercile's share of the common denominator. EITHER WAY IT IS ABOUT A QUARTER OF THE HEADLINE. AND THE '6.2x THE LARGEST CEILING THIS PROGRAMME HAS MEASURED' CLAIM IN D098 IS WITHDRAWN: the ceiling was computed on the same inflated denominator and the agent explicitly did not recompute it, flagging that as an inference rather than a measurement. NO SUCCESSOR MAY CITE THE 6.2x FIGURE.
THE_SUBSET_SPECIALNESS_EVIDENCE_IS_THIN_: The random-tier nulls - the only tests that can speak to whether the TOP TERCILE is special rather than merely refitted - give one-sided p 0.0180 (row shuffle within season) and p 0.0459 (size-matched player-season blocks). IT CLEARS ONLY JUST. AND THE z OF +12.80 THAT D098's HEADLINE RESTED ON CANNOT SPEAK TO THIS AT ALL: it comes from the within-date opponent-swap null, which HOLDS THE SUBSET FIXED and therefore tests whether defence carries signal, not whether this subset is special. THE COORDINATOR WROTE IN D098's PRESERVED DISAGREEMENT THAT THE SWAP NULL 'ARGUES STRONGLY FOR THE THRESHOLD READING' AND THAT IT WOULD 'BET THE EFFECT IS REAL'. THE AGENT'S RESPONSE IS EXACT: 'Your reading was right to be flagged as not-evidence.' The coordinator flagged its reading as not-evidence and then leaned on it anyway in the same paragraph. That is the error, and holding the lead was the only thing that prevented it from mattering.
THE_AGENT_OVERRODE_ITS_OWN_PREREGISTERED: Its hashed rule MECHANICALLY RETURNS 'REFIT ARTEFACT' on both responses. IT REPORTED 'UNRESOLVED' AND EXPLAINED WHY ITS OWN RULE WAS A BAD PROXY: the first clause compared a refit-without-defence gain against the full gain, which cannot test 'along for the ride' because D098's statistic carries the refit in BOTH arms and the two are orthogonal by construction; the second compared a percentile of a correctly-centred null against a fraction of the observed value, which tests nothing. BOTH THE MECHANICAL AND THE ADJUDICATED VERDICTS ARE IN FINDINGS.json so a reader rejecting the adjudication has the mechanical answer. This is the hardest version of the disclosure problem - a preregistered rule that fires against your own judgement - and the only honest resolutions are to obey it or to publish both with your reasoning. It published both. Preregistration is a commitment to disclose, not a commitment to be bound by a rule you can demonstrate is invalid.
what_is_actually_established: On the decision stratum, against a COMPLETE prior reference, walk-forward: THERE IS A REAL OPPONENT-DEFENCE EFFECT WORTH ABOUT dR2 +0.005 STRATUM-WIDE, which HELPS high-volume players (SSE reduction +1.3506) and HURTS low-volume ones (-0.0472 and -0.1656). made_by: Coordinator #06 - screen closed; answers the user's suggestion directly, with one population where it genuinely wins
authority: D091 authorises fitting simple estimators in the exploration lane. The champion was scored, never retrained.
question: The user suggested the WNBA may already have a stat like plus-minus that we should factor in or compete against. A walk-forward RAPM artifact exists, carries a manifest, and no screen had ever used it. Does it improve anything?
verdict: AS A FEATURE, NO. AS A REFERENCE COMPONENT, YES BUT SMALL - AND MOST OF WHAT IT BUYS IS AVAILABLE FROM AN UNADJUSTED PRIOR-SEASON BOX SCORE.
as_a_feature_no: RAPM is DETECTABLE over a complete prior-only base (pooled dR2 +0.0014 to +0.0031, permutation p 0.0005-0.0045) and NOT SIGNIFICANT on D081's decision stratum (p 0.07-0.19). The walk-forward forecast test is decisive: even WITH RAPM added, the refit forecast is WORSE THAN D094's TUNED SIMPLE ESTIMATOR ON 7 OF 8 TARGET-BY-STRATUM CELLS. And the decomposition is the tell - THE LARGEST SINGLE COMPONENT IS `has_rapm_f`, THE INDICATOR THAT A RAPM VALUE EXISTS AT ALL (64% of the points-per-minute block, 35% of points). What it mostly carries as a feature is a VETERAN-VERSUS-ROOKIE FLAG.
THE_COMPARISON_THAT_SETTLES_THE_USER_S_Q: The coordinator's brief asked whether an opponent-and-teammate-ADJUSTED estimate beats a raw one. The agent built the same-coverage UNADJUSTED comparator - the player's raw previous-season box score from master_player, which reaches back to 2021 exactly as RAPM does. IT SCORES +0.63% points / +0.85% attempts / +1.06% minutes / +0.45% points-per-minute, against RAPM's +1.04 / +0.96 / +1.33 / +0.38. INDISTINGUISHABLE ON ATTEMPTS AND MINUTES, BETTER ON POINTS-PER-MINUTE, BEHIND ONLY ON POINTS. THE OPPONENT-AND-TEAMMATE ADJUSTMENT BUYS ALMOST NOTHING OVER THE RAW BOX SCORE.
and_the_headline_is_mostly_not_RAPM_eith: The best reference variant (keep the player's own prior-season mean, fill gaps with RAPM) beats D094's incumbent on all four targets at p <= 0.016. BUT filling with the LEAGUE value and merely RE-TUNING THE SHRINKAGE STRENGTH already gives +0.61 / +0.86 / +1.20 / +0.32. RAPM's MARGINAL contribution is +0.43pp on points and +0.10 / +0.13 / +0.06 elsewhere - AND ITS OWN NEGATIVE CONTROL (a relabelled RAPM through the same map) REACHES +0.73pp ON POINTS, so even points is only about +0.31pp clear of its null. Mechanically the fill touches 2,147 walk-forward rows but ONLY 688 CARRY A REAL RAPM VALUE; the rest receive an imputed near-league constant.
THE_ONE_POPULATION_WHERE_IT_GENUINELY_WI: The two markers (RAPM exists; prior-season games > 0) AGREE ON ALL 698 ROWS: 572 veteran-returning, 126 true rookie, zero ambiguous. D092's blend reproduced exactly. VETERAN-RETURNING - RAPM GENUINELY WINS: it beats D092's placeholder by +2.28% on points (p 0.0015) and +1.03% on minutes; the same construction with the RAPM term removed gives +1.11% / -0.45% and the relabelled control +0.77% / -0.44%, so RAPM's own contribution is roughly +1.2pp points and +1.5pp minutes, clear of its null. TRUE ROOKIE - RAPM HURTS: with RAPM +2.76% against +8.31% WITHOUT it, and replacing D092's structural prior outright costs -54% on points and -51% on minutes. RAPM HAS NOTHING TO SAY ABOUT A PLAYER WITH NO PRIOR-SEASON POSSESSIONS, and the imputed value DESTROYS the draft-slot signal D092 correctly relies on. THE COORDINATOR'S INSTRUCTION TO SPLIT THESE POPULATIONS IS WHAT MADE THE RESULT INTERPRETABLE - averaged together they would have cancelled to roughly nothing.
raw_plus_minus_is_a_clean_null: Nothing anywhere - over the base, over base-plus-RAPM, on either stratum, all four targets, smallest p 0.08. RAPM's increment over base-plus-plus-minus is unchanged from over base alone (+0.00261 against +0.00258); plus-minus over base-plus-RAPM is +0.00025 and inside its null. RAPM SURVIVES PLUS-MINUS; PLUS-MINUS DOES NOT SURVIVE RAPM. The motivating hypothesis - that a game-level series carries within-season form a season-level RAPM cannot - IS NOT SUPPORTED.
three_provenance_facts_the_coordinator_s: Provenance PASSES on values: across all 1,177 rows, ZERO have max(train_seasons) >= emit season and ZERO have fit_through_season >= emit season. But: (1) `train_seasons` IS CUMULATIVE, NOT PRIOR-SEASON-ONLY - emit 2024 draws on 2021-2023, so a 2024 value is partly a 2021 fact. Still strictly prior, and a slower-moving object than the coordinator described. (2) THE KIT DOES NOT PASS THIS ARTIFACT: `check_manifest` knows only `row` and `artifact`, so for `season` granularity it returns UNVERIFIABLE with usable_at_e0_e1 False and says explicitly that is not a pass - THE VALUE-LEVEL CHECK IS WHAT DISCHARGED IT, not the manifest and not the byte match. D080 adopted `season` as a granularity value; the kit was never taught it. (3) A CROSS-SEASON COMPARABILITY HAZARD: `lambda_chosen` varies 50x across seasons (100,000 in 2022 via a fallback grid with a thin-history caveat, against 2,000 in 2024), giving a 25x spread in the scale of net_100 - handled by within-season standardisation plus a fixed-lambda primary column.
the_defect_the_agent_caught_in_its_own_w: A plain least-squares walk-forward fit scored MAE 9.30 on 2023 points where D094 scores 4.19, because three column groups were THE SAME COLUMN in the 2022 training fold. UNCAUGHT, IT WOULD HAVE REPORTED 'RAPM HURTS POINTS BY -2.9%' - THE PRE-FIX AND POST-FIX NUMBERS DIFFER IN SIGN. It was caught only by comparison against a known anchor, which is why this programme requires reproduction of a published number before any new measurement.

ruling.1_DO_NOT_ADD_RAPM_AS_A_FEATURE: Not significant where it matters, worse than a tuned simple estimator on 7 of 8 cells, and its dominant component is an existence flag rather than a value.
ruling.2_USE_IT_ONLY_FOR_VETERANS_RETURNING_AFT: +2.28% on points over D092's placeholder with its own contribution clear of its null. That population is 572 of 698 cold-start rows and is precisely where a prior-season estimate should help.
ruling.3_NEVER_APPLY_IT_TO_TRUE_ROOKIES: It costs -54% on points against D092's structural prior. The imputed near-league value destroys the draft-slot signal. This is the same shape as D102's routing counterexample: a rule that gains on one population destroys another, and the split must be explicit.
ruling.4_THE_ADJUSTMENT_IS_NOT_WHAT_IS_WORKING: A raw prior-season box score does as well or better on three of four targets. Anyone tempted to build a better adjusted metric should note that the adjustment is not where the value is - the PRIOR-SEASON INFORMATION is.
ruling.5_THE_KIT_NEEDS_TO_LEARN_season_GRANULAR: D080 adopted it as a value and check_manifest still returns UNVERIFIABLE for it. That is a real gap: the tool cannot express a category the policy recognises. Queued, not dispatched.

preserved_disagreement: The coordinator proposed this test on the reasoning that reference quality is the programme's dominant lever and that an adjusted player-quality estimate is 'the shape of a better reference'. THE SHAPE WAS RIGHT AND THE CONTENT WAS NOT: the reference did improve, and the improvement came from having ANY prior-season anchor rather than from the adjustment that makes RAPM interesting. D103 had already warned that reference quality is worth nothing under entity-swap nulls and 3.3x only under cyclic ones; the coordinator continued to describe it as the dominant lever after that correction was recorded.

made_by: Coordinator #06 - screen closed; a structural finding, a lead with the largest ceiling yet, and a program-wide correction to a rule the coordinator imposed
authority: E0 screening is coordinator-scoped. The correction to the null convention amends a coordinator ruling (D093/D096) and is coordinator-scoped. No champion fitting occurred.
question: Free throws are 17.37% of points, the channel had never been screened, and it is a HURDLE process (fta == 0 on 46.4% of rows) where this programme has only ever modelled rates. Which stage carries the predictability, and does it reach points?
verdict: THE HURDLE CARRIES IT - and it reaches points from the OPPONENT side, not the player's. This is not the clean null the brief anticipated.
THE_HURDLE_IS_REAL_AND_CONVERSION_IS_A_D: On a common denominator over the full decision stratum (n=5,111): STAGE A, REACHING THE LINE, buys +0.24016 - 72.9% of the total, and 89.6% pooled. Stage B (attempts given one) +0.17019. STAGE C, CONVERSION, ONLY +0.02792 - 8.5%. The hurdle is genuinely a hurdle rather than a low rate: mean attempts of 1.9011 implies a Poisson P(zero) of 0.1494 against an OBSERVED 0.4640, an excess of +0.3146, and the hurdle alone is 45.74% of the variance in free-throw makes. A player's own prior free-throw percentage scores +0.0296 on the decision stratum and MINUS 0.0993 pooled against a single game's percentage - conversion is not forecastable and should not be pursued.
the_D099_trap_was_avoided_and_named: Stage C shows an oracle R2 of 0.887 with only 11.31% irreducible, which looks like the most predictable quantity in the programme. IT IS AN ARTEFACT - its oracle exposure is the realised attempt count, the same shape D097 caught in total rebounds. The agent flagged it and put all cross-stage comparison on one denominator.
THE_PLAYER_SIDE_IS_CLOSED_ON_ARITHMETIC_: Oracle ladder, decision stratum: free-throw points are 69.46% irreducible with headroom 0.080 - ESSENTIALLY IDENTICAL TO ASSISTS' 0.082 - against the points anchor's 0.161. The ladder is calibrated: the anchor reproduces D097's 51.68% at 51.6840% on the identical n. SO D097 RULING 2 APPLIES UNCHANGED to the player's own free-throw production, and the player's own free-throw forecast is worth MINUS 0.001014 out of sample.
THE_OPPONENT_SIDE_IS_OPEN_AND_CARRIES_TH: Opponent free-throws-allowed per game on POINTS, decision stratum: dR2 0.002951 at p_correct 0.0017 and family-wise 0.0050 - 1.43x the 0.002057 benchmark, the largest this programme has measured. One standard deviation moves points by 0.41 against a response sd of 7.58. It survives walk-forward on earlier seasons only at +0.002865. THE CAVEATS MUST TRAVEL WITH IT: the sign is positive in 4 of 4 seasons but THE MAGNITUDE IS DOMINATED BY 2024 (betas 0.031 / 0.162 / 0.119 / 0.435), and IT DOES NOT REPRODUCE POOLED (p 0.245). The noise floor at this n is 4.9e-04, so it sits about 6x above noise. RAISED, NOT ACCEPTED.
D085_REPRODUCES_ON_A_TARGET_IT_NEVER_TES: The brief warned that D085's foul-draw interaction cleared family-wise and then went to exactly zero once its own main effects were controlled. THE SAME THING HAPPENS HERE. Opponent terms clear decisively across 44 cells - and once opponent free-throws-allowed is in the base, EXACTLY ONE STILL CLEARS. M01 collapses from 0.001990 to 0.000004, roughly 500-fold; others by 54x and 40x. FOULS CONCEDED, FREE-THROW-RATE ALLOWED, HURDLE-RATE ALLOWED AND PACE ARE ALL ONE NUMBER RESTATED - how many free throws a team gives up. And the interaction over a base carrying both its own main effects reaches family-wise p 0.539 and clears nowhere. THE OPPONENT FREE-THROW CHANNEL HAS EXACTLY ONE DEGREE OF FREEDOM.

THE_STRUCTURAL_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_THE_MOS.the_asymmetry: THE CHAMPION MODELS NO FREE THROWS AT ALL IN THE PLAYER ARM. `player_scoring_distribution` is an EWMA of prior per-36 TOTAL points multiplied by an EWMA of minutes, expressed as one scalar inside a residual-quantile envelope. Free-throw makes, attempts and fouls drawn are DROPPED AT THE FRAME BOUNDARY, with zero references across sixteen champion files. THE DATA WAS AVAILABLE, NOT MISSING. AND THE TEAM ARM CARRIES AN EXPLICIT FREE-THROW CHANNEL - so the same programme decomposed TEAM scoring into free throws and did not decompose PLAYER scoring.
THE_STRUCTURAL_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_THE_MOS.the_identity_that_sharpens_it: The agent verified to 1.3e-15 that the three hurdle stages multiply exactly to the prior mean of free-throw makes. THE DECOMPOSITION IS EXACTLY MEAN-PRESERVING. It can therefore only ever pay in DISTRIBUTIONAL SHAPE - which is precisely what a scalar-plus-envelope architecture cannot hold, and precisely where a 46.4% zero mass lives. SO THE FINDING IS NOT 'A FEATURE IS MISSING' BUT 'THE ARCHITECTURE CANNOT REPRESENT THIS QUANTITY'. That is the same class as D092's constant-emitting fallback, and this programme has learned that structural findings pay where feature findings do not.

A_PROGRAM_WIDE_CORRECTION_TO_A_RULE_THE_.the_finding: THE WITHIN-PLAYER CYCLIC SHIFT IS DEGENERATE FOR BETWEEN-PLAYER CANDIDATES. Handed a signal of exactly 0.002057 by construction, it returns p = 1.0000 in 0 of 15 configurations. THE MECHANISM IS OBVIOUS ONCE STATED: a rotation preserves each player's own mean, and a between-player trait varies precisely between those means - so the null destroys nothing the statistic depends on and has NO POWER AT ALL.
A_PROGRAM_WIDE_CORRECTION_TO_A_RULE_THE_.why_this_is_the_coordinator_s_problem: After D093 the coordinator made the cyclic shift MANDATORY and had the kit REFUSE the plain within-player shuffle (D096, break B3). THAT WAS RIGHT FOR AUTOCORRELATED WITHIN-PLAYER REGRESSORS, WHICH IS WHAT D093 MEASURED - and it was over-generalised into a blanket rule. The kit now refuses a null in favour of one that, for a whole class of candidate, cannot detect anything.
A_PROGRAM_WIDE_CORRECTION_TO_A_RULE_THE_.THE_CONSEQUENCE_THAT_MUST_BE_ACTED_ON: ANY VERDICT IN THIS LEDGER RESTING ON A CYCLIC SHIFT AGAINST A BETWEEN-PLAYER CANDIDATE SHOULD READ 'NOT ESTABLISHED', NOT 'ABSENT'. The specific case the coordinator has already identified and flags for re-examination is D097, where the rebound screen's STRONGEST candidate - a player's own restricted-area share, which is a between-player trait - was killed at cyclic p 0.9967 after surviving the entity-swap null at 0.0017. THAT KILL MAY BE AN ARTEFACT OF A POWERLESS NULL AND MUST BE RE-RUN under a powered one before it stands. The coordinator recorded that episode as proof the D093 repair had 'paid for itself'; it may instead have been the repair's first false negative.
A_PROGRAM_WIDE_CORRECTION_TO_A_RULE_THE_.the_remedy: The agent built a player-swap null with 6-of-6 detection on the injected signal and took its verdicts from powered nulls only, retaining the degenerate one in full but excluding it. THE STANDING RULE IS NOW: MATCH THE NULL TO WHERE THE CANDIDATE VARIES - cyclic for within-player autocorrelated series, entity or player swap for between-player traits - AND VERIFY POWER BY INJECTING A KNOWN SIGNAL BEFORE TRUSTING ANY NULL. A null that cannot detect a planted effect is the vacuous-control trap (D093 K7) in a new place.

the_agents_own_defects: Two, both caught by its own guards and documented. preserved_disagreement: The coordinator notes it has now imposed two program-wide rules this session that turned out narrower than stated - the cyclic null here, and reference quality as 'the dominant lever' which D103 showed is worth nothing under entity-swap nulls. BOTH WERE GENERALISED FROM A SINGLE WELL-MEASURED CASE. The pattern is that a real finding in one regime becomes a blanket rule without anyone asking where the regime ends, and the kit then ENFORCES the over-generalisation, which makes it harder to notice. A successor should treat every mandatory rule in this ledger as carrying an unstated scope condition until someone checks it.

made_by: Coordinator #06 - the user's aggregation directive answered; the coordinator's own redundancy prediction was wrong
authority: D091 authorises composing and fitting estimators in the exploration lane. The champion was scored, never refitted. No production change is enacted.
question: The user directed: 'i don't care how small an improvement is i want fractional improvements to aggregate.' Do they, or does stacking components selected for being positive just aggregate selection noise?
verdict: THEY DO AGGREGATE, AND IT IS NOT NOISE - THE PLACEBO PROVES IT. But the gain is almost entirely outside the population anyone would bet on, and the smallest components did not contribute at all.
THE_STACK_IS_REAL_AND_THE_PLACEBO_SETTLE: One row set (13,808 rows, 472 player-season clusters), one denominator per cell, walk-forward, clustered paired sign-flip at 4,000 draws. POOLED: points +0.0342, minutes +0.0494, attempts +0.0430, points-per-minute +0.0143, all at p 0.00025; pooled MAE falls 3.7% to 6.4%. THE PLACEBO STACK - same component count, same functional forms, features with no real relationship, identical pipeline - IS NEGATIVE ON 9 OF 12 CELLS, and its largest positive is +0.00039 at p 0.243, EIGHTY-SEVEN TIMES SMALLER than the real stack on the same cell. The no-op and self-comparison controls return dR2 exactly 0.0 at p exactly 1.0 on all four targets. THE FAILURE MODE THE SCREEN WAS BUILT AROUND DID NOT OCCUR: the user's thesis survives its own strongest test.
THE_SENTENCE_THAT_MATTERS_AND_IT_IS_THE_: ZERO OF THE 947 ROUTED ROWS ARE IN THE DECISION STRATUM. The maximum prior-appearance count among routed rows is 5; the stratum requires at least 8. SO THE PROGRAMME'S LARGEST, DOUBLE-CORROBORATED COMPONENT CONTRIBUTES EXACTLY NOTHING TO THE BETTING POPULATION - by construction, not by weakness. Strip the routed rows out and THE ENTIRE SIX-COMPONENT STACK IS WORTH +0.0015 ON POINTS (p 0.045) AND +0.0019 ON POINTS-PER-MINUTE (p 0.007), AND NOTHING AT ALL ON MINUTES OR ATTEMPTS. The headline pooled numbers are real and they are a statement about repairing players nobody would bet on.
the_decision_stratum_is_where_the_honest: On the stratum: points +0.0035 (p 0.029), points-per-minute +0.0068 (p 0.00075), attempts +0.0011 (p 0.300, nil), and MINUTES ACTUALLY WORSE at -0.0052 (p 0.00025). A stack that is strongly positive pooled and negative on one target where it matters is not a stack that can be deployed as-is.

THE_ABLATION_MATRIX_IS_THE_DELIVERABLE.load_bearing: THE FALLBACK ROUTE carries the pooled result (+0.0326 / +0.0497 / +0.0424 / +0.0125) AND IS ZERO ON THE DECISION STRATUM. OWN-PRIOR-SEASON SHRINKAGE is load-bearing (+0.0059 points, +0.0249 points-per-minute). AND THE OPPONENT-DEFENCE TERM IS THE ONLY COMPONENT THAT WORKS WHERE IT MATTERS - points +0.0033 (p 0.020) and points-per-minute +0.0059 (p 0.0013) on the decision stratum. The one lead the coordinator has been holding as RAISED-NOT-ACCEPTED is the only thing carrying the betting population.
THE_ABLATION_MATRIX_IS_THE_DELIVERABLE.not_load_bearing: PER-TARGET HALF-LIVES contribute approximately nothing (-0.0001 to 0), which is a genuine surprise - D094 measured a 20x spread in optimal half-life across targets and it does not survive composition. HOME/AWAY is at most +0.00037 with every p above 0.17, and sits 3 to 100 times BELOW D103's detection floor - it could not have registered.
THE_ABLATION_MATRIX_IS_THE_DELIVERABLE.ACTIVELY_HARMFUL: TEAMMATE VOLUME SUBTRACTS. On the decision stratum it costs MINUS 0.0049 ON MINUTES AT p 0.0005, AND THAT SINGLE COMPONENT IS WHAT MAKES THE STACK'S MINUTES RESULT NEGATIVE THERE. D101 had already downgraded its evidence when re-priced against a strong reference; this is the same lead failing a second, independent way.

WHERE_THE_CURVE_FLATTENS_WHICH_IS_WHAT_T: Points, adding largest-first: +0.0268 (routing) -> +0.0268 (half-lives, nil) -> +0.0328 (shrinkage) -> +0.0345 (opponent defence) -> +0.0341 (teammate volume, BACKWARDS) -> +0.0342 (home). FLAT AFTER STEP FOUR OF SIX. Minutes flattens after step one. THE TWO SMALLEST GENUINELY-ESTABLISHED EFFECTS IN THE LEDGER - teammate volume and home advantage - DID NOT AGGREGATE, AND ONE SUBTRACTED. That is the empirical floor on the user's strategy: fractional improvements aggregate down to roughly the detection floor and then stop, and below it they add variance rather than signal.
THE_COORDINATOR_S_PREDICTION_WAS_WRONG: The coordinator predicted, in advance and in writing, that the components would prove substantially REDUNDANT - that teammate volume, opponent defence, fallback routing and home advantage all ultimately route through minutes and volume, so the stack would gain far less than the sum of its parts. SUM-OF-PARTS OVER WHOLE IS 0.85 TO 1.16 ON 11 OF 12 CELLS. NOT REDUNDANT. But the agent immediately qualified it in a way the coordinator would not have: only TWO components carry anything and they are not competing for the same signal - one repairs a degenerate region and the other adds an opponent term elsewhere. YOU DO NOT GET REDUNDANCY WHEN YOU ONLY HAVE TWO THINGS. The prediction was wrong and the qualification makes it moot rather than vindicating the alternative.
one_genuine_interaction_found: On points-per-minute pooled, sum-of-parts is 2.72x the whole: ROUTING ALONE IS NEGATIVE (-0.0125) AND SHRINKAGE RESCUES IT (+0.0249). A real interaction, and exactly why D102's verify-per-target rule exists - a component that helps three targets can hurt a fourth, and only composition reveals it.
availability_cannot_enter_the_stack_even: The long-absence recalibration improves v15 Brier by +1.40% at p 0.027 against a placebo of +0.02% - a real effect. BUT IT IS A BINARY RESPONSE and cannot share a denominator with the continuous targets under the D101 comparability rule, AND, as the agent observed, EVERY SCORED ROW IN THE STACK IS A GAME THE PLAYER ACTUALLY PLAYED - so an availability correction has nothing to act on there. It is a separate deliverable, not a stack component.
two_HIGH_defects_disclosed_and_the_first: THE INTERCEPT CONFOUND: fitting a feature as [1, x] against a bare reference smuggled in a walk-forward INTERCEPT RECALIBRATION, so the first draft returned a home-advantage dR2 of MINUS 1.379e-03 at p 0.0015 - THIRTY TIMES D104's ARITHMETIC CEILING AND THE WRONG SIGN. It was fixed by holding an intercept in both arms, and CRITICALLY IT WAS CAUGHT ONLY BY COMPARING AGAINST D104's PUBLISHED CEILING, NOT BY ANY GUARD IN THE KIT OR THE PROTOCOL. A published arithmetic ceiling functioned as a smoke alarm for a defect no null would have caught, which is a use for ceilings nobody had anticipated. THE SECOND: the preregistered common row set required every feature finite, which deleted 885 of the 947 routed rows; the trigger was a printed row count of ZERO with no outcome statistic seen, and the amendment added and dropped no components.
a_sharp_methodological_observation_worth: Reproducing the teammate-volume figure exposed that ITS PUBLISHED VALUE HOLDS ONLY VIA THE POINTS-PER-MINUTE-PROPAGATED ROUTE - a direct points regression on identical rows gives 2.83 TIMES MORE at the SAME cluster p (0.0350 against the published 0.0345). SO p IS DENOMINATOR-INVARIANT AND dR2 IS NOT. Two screens can agree exactly on significance and differ threefold on effect size, which is a cleaner statement of the D099/D101 denominator problem than either of those entries managed.

ruling.1_THE_USER_S_STRATEGY_IS_VALIDATED_WITH_: Fractional improvements DO aggregate and the gain is not selection noise. But the curve flattens after four of six components, and effects at or below the detection floor did not contribute - one subtracted. AGGREGATION IS REAL AND IT IS BOUNDED, and the bound is roughly D103's floor.
ruling.2_THE_POOLED_HEADLINE_MUST_NEVER_BE_QUOT: +0.0342 pooled and +0.0035 on the decision stratum are the same stack. The difference is entirely a population nobody would bet on. Anyone citing the pooled figure as a betting improvement is misreading it.
ruling.3_TEAMMATE_VOLUME_SHOULD_BE_DROPPED: It has now failed twice independently - downgraded on re-pricing (D101) and actively harmful in composition (D109). It is the clearest candidate for removal from the live lead list.
ruling.4_THE_OPPONENT_DEFENCE_TERM_IS_NOW_THE_P: And it remains RAISED-NOT-ACCEPTED (D099), 2024-dominated and not reproducing pooled (D108's related finding). THAT IS AN UNCOMFORTABLE PLACE FOR THE PROGRAMME TO BE and should be stated plainly rather than smoothed.

preserved_disagreement: The coordinator notes that the most encouraging framing available - 'a six-component stack cuts pooled points error by 3.7%' - is also the most misleading sentence in this entry, because it is carried by 947 rows the programme has separately established are the ones a forecaster should decline to forecast at all (D076's abstention rule). THE PROGRAMME HAS SIMULTANEOUSLY CONCLUDED THAT THOSE ROWS SHOULD BE ABSTAINED ON AND THAT FIXING THEM IS ITS LARGEST MEASURED GAIN. Both are true, they are not contradictory - abstention and repair are alternative treatments of the same defect - but a reader taking either in isolation gets the wrong picture, and no entry before this one put them side by side.
